figurative_meaning_en: half raw, half ripe (often referring to hair that is partially grey)
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার চুল কাঁচাপাকা হয়ে গেছে বয়সের সাথে।
এই ফলটা কাঁচাপাকা, খাওয়া যাবে না।
example_sentences_in_english: His hair has turned salt and pepper with age.
This fruit is half-ripe; it can't be eaten yet.
note: Primarily used to describe hair that is a mix of black and grey, indicating middle age.
